verses.original: מִזְמ֥וֹר לְתוֹדָ֑ה הָרִ֥יעוּ לַ֝יהוָ֗ה כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: miz·mō·wr lə·ṯō·w·ḏāh hā·rî·‘ū Yah·weh kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: A Psalm of thanksgiving Make a joyful noise to the LORD all the earth

verses.original: עִבְד֣וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה בְּשִׂמְחָ֑ה בֹּ֥אוּ לְ֝פָנָ֗יו בִּרְנָנָֽה׃
verses.literal: Serve the LORD with gladness come into His presence with joyful songs

verses.original: דְּע֗וּ כִּֽי־ יְהוָה֮ ה֤וּא אֱלֹ֫הִ֥ים הֽוּא־ עָ֭שָׂנוּ וְלֹא אֲנַ֑חְנוּ עַ֝מּ֗וֹ וְצֹ֣אן מַרְעִיתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: də·‘ū kî- Yah·weh hū ’ĕ·lō·hîm hū- ‘ā·śā·nū wə·lō ’ă·naḥ·nū ‘am·mōw wə·ṣōn mar·‘î·ṯōw
verses.literal: Know that the LORD is God It is He who made us and we are His we are His people and the sheep of His pasture

verses.original: בֹּ֤אוּ שְׁעָרָ֨יו׀ בְּתוֹדָ֗ה חֲצֵרֹתָ֥יו בִּתְהִלָּ֑ה הֽוֹדוּ־ ל֝֗וֹ בָּרֲכ֥וּ שְׁמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bō·’ū šə·‘ā·rāw bə·ṯō·w·ḏāh ḥă·ṣê·rō·ṯāw biṯ·hil·lāh hō·w·ḏū- lōw bā·ră·ḵū šə·mōw
verses.literal: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise give thanks to Him and bless His name

verses.original: כִּי־ ט֣וֹב יְ֭הֹוָה לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּ֑וֹ וְעַד־ דֹּ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר אֱמוּנָתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṭō·wḇ Yah·weh lə·‘ō·w·lām ḥas·dōw wə·‘aḏ- dōr wā·ḏōr ’ĕ·mū·nā·ṯōw
verses.literal: For the LORD is good and His loving devotion endures forever His faithfulness continues to all generations
